schema_version.description: Schema version identifier. Must be 2 for this format.

entries.description: One record per installed resource, sorted by resource_name.

resource_name.description: Stable resource identity matching catalog_id format (type::folder::name).

provider_id.description: References the ProviderEntry.id that supplied this resource.

resolved_version.description: Commit SHA or tag actually installed. Empty string for migrated records.

previous_version.description: Commit SHA or tag of the prior install before the last update. Empty on first install.

installed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of last install or update. Empty for migrated records.

managed_files.description: All files written to disk during the last install of this resource.

path.description: File path relative to the project root, using forward slashes.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex-encoded SHA256 hash of the file content as written to disk.
